blocks.orig: October is the sweet spot between Tanzania’s busy dry season and the start of the short rains. While July and August attract the biggest crowds, October still offers all the wildlife magic — but with far more availability and often lower prices.
blocks.html: October falls in the sweet spot between Tanzania’s crowded dry season and the arrival of the short rains. July and August draw the largest crowds, yet in October you still get all the wildlife magic — but with far more availability and often lower prices.

blocks.orig: Why October is a Hidden Safari Gem in Tanzania
blocks.html: Why October is Tanzania’s hidden safari gem

blocks.orig: October is the kind of month that savvy travelers whisper about — because it has all the magic of peak safari season without the hustle and bustle. Herds of wildebeest and zebras are still roaming the Serengeti, elephants are gathered in Tarangire, and big cats are never far behind.
blocks.html: October is the sort of month that well-informed travellers quietly recommend to each other, because it brings all the magic of peak safari season without the hustle and bustle. Wildebeest and zebra herds still wander the Serengeti, elephants gather in Tarangire, and the big cats are never far away.

blocks.orig: The dry season is at its peak, so wildlife naturally congregates around the few remaining water sources, making sightings easier and more dramatic. What’s more, many lodges still have availability and often lower rates compared to July and August, so you can enjoy luxury experiences at friendlier prices. Fewer safari vehicles in the parks mean you’ll often feel like you’ve got front-row seats to nature’s greatest show — just you, your guide, and the animals. October really is the perfect mix of great game viewing, comfortable weather, and more relaxed travel.
blocks.html: With the dry season at its height, animals naturally cluster around the few water sources that remain, so sightings are easier and more dramatic. On top of that, many lodges still have rooms free, often at lower rates than in July and August, which lets you enjoy luxury experiences at friendlier prices. With fewer safari vehicles in the parks, it often feels as though you have front-row seats to nature’s greatest show — just you, your guide and the animals. October truly combines great game viewing, pleasant weather and a more relaxed way of travelling.

blocks.orig: October sits right at the end of Tanzania’s long dry season, and that means plenty of sunshine, blue skies, and warm days. Temperatures average between 25–30°C (77–86°F), which makes for ideal safari conditions — hot enough for adventure but not unbearably so. Nights and early mornings are cooler, which adds a refreshing start to your game drives.
blocks.html: Falling at the very end of Tanzania’s long dry season, October brings lots of sunshine, blue skies and warm days. Average temperatures of 25–30°C (77–86°F) make for ideal safari conditions: warm enough for adventure, yet never unbearable. Early mornings and nights are cooler, giving your game drives a refreshing start.

blocks.orig: Rain is minimal throughout the month, with the first hints of the short rains only arriving towards the very end of October (and even then, showers are usually brief and refreshing). This makes October one of the most comfortable months to combine safaris with a few relaxing days on Zanzibar’s beaches.
blocks.html: Hardly any rain falls during the month; the first signs of the short rains only appear right at the end of October, and even then the showers tend to be short and refreshing. That is why October is among the most comfortable months for pairing a safari with a few restful days on the beaches of Zanzibar.

blocks.orig: Now you might be wondering, what about wildlife spotting? Don’t you worry…there is plenty to see!
blocks.html: You may now be asking yourself how the wildlife spotting is. Don’t worry about that…there is plenty to see!

blocks.orig: The Great Migration is still in action during October. Large herds of wildebeest and zebras linger in the northern Serengeti, and depending on the year, you might still catch dramatic Mara River crossings. Even if the crossings are winding down, predators remain active and plentiful, waiting for the weakened animals to pass through.
blocks.html: In October the Great Migration is still under way. Big herds of wildebeest and zebras remain in the northern Serengeti and, depending on the year, you may still witness dramatic crossings of the Mara River. Even when the crossings are tailing off, predators stay numerous and active, lying in wait for weakened animals to pass.

blocks.orig: The Ngorongoro Crater is spectacular year-round, but October offers excellent visibility and fantastic wildlife activity. Lions, elephants, and endangered black rhinos are all easier to spot as the open landscapes remain golden and dry. With fewer tourists, your crater experience feels more intimate.
blocks.html: The Ngorongoro Crater impresses in any month, but in October the visibility is superb and wildlife activity is high. Because the open landscapes stay golden and dry, lions, elephants and endangered black rhinos are easier to find. And with fewer tourists around, your time in the crater feels more intimate.

blocks.orig: October is one of the best times to visit Tarangire, often called “the land of the giants.” Enormous elephant herds gather around the Tarangire River, sometimes numbering in the hundreds. Alongside elephants, you’ll see giraffes, buffalo, and predators lurking nearby.
blocks.html: For Tarangire, often nicknamed “the land of the giants”, October ranks among the best months to visit. Huge elephant herds, at times numbering in the hundreds, gather along the Tarangire River. Besides the elephants, you will spot giraffes, buffalo and predators prowling close by.

blocks.orig: If you’re the kind of traveler who wants the full safari experience but doesn’t like following the crowds, October is your sweet spot.
blocks.html: If you are the sort of traveller who wants the complete safari experience without following the crowds, then October is your sweet spot.

blocks.orig: Combine Safari & Zanzibar in October
blocks.html: Combine safari & Zanzibar in October

blocks.orig: A safari is just the beginning of your October adventure — and Zanzibar is the perfect ending. After days of thrilling game drives, swap your safari jeep for a beach lounger with turquoise ocean views.
blocks.html: Your October adventure starts with a safari, and Zanzibar makes the perfect finale. After days of exciting game drives, trade your safari jeep for a beach lounger looking out over a turquoise ocean.

blocks.orig: October in Zanzibar is warm, tropical, and sunny with average highs of 28–30°C (82–86°F). The waters are calm and clear, perfect for snorkeling and diving among coral reefs. Spice farms are in full swing, offering aromatic tours of cloves, cinnamon, and nutmeg. And in Stone Town, you’ll find winding alleys, bustling markets, and rooftop restaurants where you can soak up the island’s rich culture.
blocks.html: In October, Zanzibar is warm, tropical and sunny, with average highs of 28–30°C (82–86°F). The sea is calm and clear, ideal for snorkelling and diving over the coral reefs. The spice farms are in full operation, with fragrant tours of cloves, cinnamon and nutmeg. And Stone Town awaits with its winding alleys, lively markets and rooftop restaurants where you can soak up the island’s rich culture.

blocks.orig: With fewer international visitors in October, you’ll often feel like you’ve got whole stretches of beach to yourself. It’s the ideal month to blend safari excitement with barefoot relaxation.
blocks.html: Because fewer international visitors come in October, you will often have whole stretches of beach to yourself. It is the perfect month to pair the thrill of a safari with barefoot relaxation.
